description: Revestor is rental portfolio and tax-readiness software for U.S. landlords. Connect it to query live Revestor records after OAuth consent, including properties, REPS hours, expenses, and mileage. With write access, assistants can propose time logs, mileage, or unclassified expenses; proposals stay pending in Revestor AI Review until you accept them. Connector traffic does not use Gemini or Revestor AI credits. Output is records and status only, not tax, legal, or accounting advice.

defaultPrompt: Using Revestor, how many REPS hours do I have this year?
